from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,pandas as pd
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_revision_prior_policy_clock_v1'
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,v):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));freeze=json.loads((out/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (out/'result.json').exists() and sha(out/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
for rel,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items():assert sha(root/rel)==h,rel
rec=json.loads((out/'new_source_receipt.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert rec['status']=='SAVED_ORIGINAL' and sha(root/rec['path'])==rec['sha256']
soup=BeautifulSoup((root/rec['path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
full=' '.join(soup.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
assert 'May 01, 2024' in full and 'For release at 2:00 p.m. EDT' in full
paras=[' '.join(p.get_text(' ',strip=True).split()) for p in soup.find_all('p')]
qt=[p for p in paras if 'Beginning in June' in p and 'monthly redemption cap on Treasury securities' in p];assert len(qt)==1
m=re.search(r'Beginning in June.*?from \$([\d,.]+) billion to \$([\d,.]+) billion',qt[0]);assert m
oldcap,newcap=int(m.group(1).replace(',','')),int(m.group(2).replace(',',''))
assert (oldcap,newcap)==(60,25)
mbs=[p for p in paras if 'maintain the monthly redemption cap on agency debt' in p];assert len(mbs)==1 and '$35 billion' in mbs[0]
rate=[p for p in paras if 'maintain the target range for the federal funds rate' in p]
assert len(rate)==1 and '5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent' in rate[0]
fed_time=datetime(2024,5,1,14,0,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))
shanghai=fed_time.astimezone(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
metadata={x['quarter']:x for x in json.loads((parent/'actual_release_metadata.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
assert metadata['2024Q2']['body_date_text']=='April 29, 2024' and metadata['2024Q3']['body_date_text']=='July 29, 2024'
pdfs={x['quarter']:x for x in json.loads((parent/'所有原PDF页面文字.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
priorline=pdfs['2024Q2']['pages'][0]['text'].splitlines()[-1]
assert priorline.startswith('2024 April 29, 2024')
def values(line):
    s=re.sub(r'^.*?[A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}\s+','',line)
    tokens=re.findall(r'\(?-?[\d,]+\)?',s);assert len(tokens)==7,line
    return [(-int(t[1:-1].replace(',','')) if t.startswith('(') else int(t.replace(',',''))) for t in tokens]
oldvalues=values(priorline);assert oldvalues==[486,847,-260,586,100,850,-177]
lines=pdfs['2024Q3']['pages'][0]['text'].splitlines()
i=next(i for i,s in enumerate(lines) if 'July 29, 2024' in s and i+1<len(lines) and lines[i+1].startswith('Forecast Revisions'))
previous=values(lines[i-1]);current=values(lines[i]);assert previous==oldvalues
assert current==[501,740,-167,574,72,850,-91]
rawrecords=[
    {'quarter':'2024Q3','source_current_quarter':'2024Q2','forecast_publication_date':'2024-04-29','row_kind':'原首次下季度预估','financing_need':486,'borrow':847,'other_sources':-260,'cash_end':850,'soma_memo':-177,'raw_line':priorline},
    {'quarter':'2024Q3','source_current_quarter':'2024Q3','forecast_publication_date':'2024-07-29','row_kind':'当前表复述旧预估','financing_need':486,'borrow':847,'other_sources':-260,'cash_end':850,'soma_memo':-177,'raw_line':lines[i-1]},
    {'quarter':'2024Q3','source_current_quarter':'2024Q3','forecast_publication_date':'2024-07-29','row_kind':'当前本季度预估','financing_need':501,'borrow':740,'other_sources':-167,'cash_end':850,'soma_memo':-91,'raw_line':lines[i]}]
pd.DataFrame(rawrecords).to_csv(out/'两当前原表的同Q3预估及旧行交叉.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
fields={x['quarter']:x for x in json.loads((parent/'原公告字段及原因记录.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
q=fields['2024Q3'];assert q['soma_memo_revision_reported']==86 and q['all_other_sources_revision_reported']==94
treasuryrec=next(x for x in json.loads((parent/'release_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['receipts'] if x['quarter']=='2024Q3')
treasurytext=' '.join(BeautifulSoup((root/treasuryrec['path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser').get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
assert 'lower Federal Reserve System Open Market Account (SOMA) redemptions' in treasurytext
save('Fed原声明关键段及正式时点.json',{'url':rec['url'],'sha256':rec['sha256'],'formal_release_new_york':fed_time.isoformat(),
    'formal_release_shanghai':shanghai,'qt_paragraph':qt[0],'mbs_paragraph':mbs[0],'policy_rate_paragraph':rate[0],
    'effective_month':'2024-06','actual_historic_receipt_verified':False,'first_historical_vintage_verified':False})
gap=(date(2024,7,29)-date(2024,5,1)).days
events=[{'event':'原季度借款计划','body_date':'2024-04-29','formal_release_shanghai':None,'available_proxy_only':True,
    'finding':'同Q3预估SOMA memo−177、借款847；实际旧原表行与7月复述金额一致。'},
    {'event':'Fed公布减缓Treasury缩表','body_date':'2024-05-01','formal_release_shanghai':shanghai,'available_proxy_only':False,
    'finding':'自6月，月度上限60→25十亿美元；MBS上限35不改，政策利率5.25%—5.50%维持。'},
    {'event':'本季度借款预估更新','body_date':'2024-07-29','formal_release_shanghai':None,'available_proxy_only':True,
    'finding':'SOMA memo−177→−91，减少86；借款报告下修106，其他融资报告改善94。'}]
pd.DataFrame(events).to_csv(out/'上游政策与两季度计划公开顺序.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
gate={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'evaluated_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
    'status':'SOURCE_QUALIFIED_PRIOR_POLICY_CHRONOLOGY_ONLY','source_objects':5,'new_sources':1,'reused_sources':4,
    'fed_body_date_and_formal_time_located':True,'old_and_new_cap_and_effective_month_located':True,
    'original_april_next_quarter_row_matches_july_old_row':True,
    'prior_forecast_before_fed_policy_before_current_forecast':True,'policy_precedes_current_treasury_by_calendar_days':gap,
    'source_gate_passed':True,'entire_86_billion_preanticipated_amount_proven':False,'market_price_full_absorption_proven':False,
    'market_consensus_surprise_proven':False,'historic_first_vintage_verified':False,'new_equity_labels':0,'fits':0,'accounts':0}
save('source_gate.json',gate)
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E13','completed_at':gate['evaluated_at'],
    'status':'COMPLETED_SOMA_UPSTREAM_POLICY_PREANNOUNCED_FACT_ONLY',
    'classification':'PROGRESS_UPSTREAM_CAUSE_PUBLICATION_CHRONOLOGY',
    'quarter':'2024Q3','prior_treasury_body_date':'2024-04-29','fed_announcement_new_york':fed_time.isoformat(),
    'fed_announcement_shanghai':shanghai,'effective_month':'2024-06','current_treasury_body_date':'2024-07-29',
    'earlier_policy_calendar_days':gap,'treasury_monthly_redemption_cap_before':60,'treasury_monthly_redemption_cap_after':25,
    'agency_debt_mbs_cap_unchanged':35,'fed_policy_rate_maintained':'5.25%—5.50%',
    'quarter_soma_redemption_estimate_before':177,'quarter_soma_redemption_estimate_after':91,'quarter_soma_reduction':86,
    'reported_borrowing_revision':-106,'reported_other_sources_revision':94,'cash_contribution':-28,'reported_financing_need_revision':15,
    'simple_three_month_cap_reduction':3*(oldcap-newcap),'simple_cap_change_minus_observed_soma_change':3*(oldcap-newcap)-86,
    'reject_forcing_cap_times_three_to_equal_soma_amount':True,'soma_memo_not_added_twice':True,
    'accepted':'QT减速上游安排在7月借款更新前89日已正式公开，不可把7月SOMA预估变化整体自动命名为当日新QT政策意外。',
    'not_established':['86全部为事前市场预期金额','政策已经完全反映在指数价格','7月原预算/现金/到期预测无新信息','纯货币政策因果效应或指数可交易优势'],
    'source_objects':5,'new_downloads':1,'reused_source_objects':4,'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,
    'old_32_fomc_event_returns_not_rerun':True,'E6_E9_E12_rejections_preserved':True,
    'account_net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','independent_validation':False,'goal_achieved':False,
    'new_repository_source_code_edits':0,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False}
save('result.json',result)
cases=[{'quarter':x['quarter'],'soma_memo_revision_reported':x['soma_memo_revision_reported'],'actual_release_date':x['actual_release_date']}
    for x in fields.values() if x['current_table_three_rows_available'] and x['soma_memo_revision_reported']!=0]
assert [x['quarter'] for x in cases]==['2022Q3','2024Q2','2024Q3','2025Q2','2025Q4']
proposal={'proposal_id':'E14_ALL_NONZERO_SOMA_REVISION_PRIOR_INFORMATION_SOURCES','status':'PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN',
    'question':'全部原表可见非零SOMA预估修订中，哪些上游政策安排在当前借款更新前已公开、哪些量差仍未解释？',
    'case_selection':'按E11全部15有字段季度SOMA memo报告修订非零，不按股市收益选择；完整16覆盖中2023Q2该字段仍未知，不填零。',
    'fixed_source_cases':cases,'unknown_soma_quarter':'2023Q2',
    'bounded_source_candidate':'复用E13 2024-05-01、旧2025-10-29原声明及全部Treasury原件；最多3新Fed原页（2022-05-04声明/资产负债表计划、2025-03-19声明），不为解释2024Q2的12反推未来May1政策。',
    'no_new_equity_labels_or_fits_in_source_phase':True,'original_E12_model_rejection_preserved':True,
    'chronology_does_not_certify_full_amount_anticipated_or_price_absorbed':True,
    'next_model_not_registered':True,'independent_validation':False,'orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False}
save('next_experiment.json',proposal)
print('E13事实：Fed减速政策5月1日公开、自6月实施，早于7月29日借款更新89个日历日。')
print('上限60→25十亿美元，政策利率维持；Q3 SOMA预估177→91（−86）；上限差×3=105，不能强制与86等同。')
print('只接受政策先公开；不证明86完整市场预期或价格已吸收。0新股市标签/拟合/账户。E14只全部5非零原表季度的来源提案。')
